rules.description: Volume shifted once at the 0.18 -> 0.19 transition and has been stable ever since: 117495.573 mm3 in 0.18 (the native baseline), 118253.648 mm3 in 0.19, 0.20, 0.21, 1.0, 1.1 and 1.1.3 alike. Surface area moved the other way in the same step (29199.975 -> 29100.698, -0.34%, within the 0.5% area tolerance so it does not fail). More volume with less area points at a subtractive feature resolving differently; the body stays valid in every version. A settled six-year-old difference rather than a live regression, so it is accepted rather than filed. Scoped to volume on this one body, so a further change here still fails.
